TGO.note: A symposium on AI and democracy is described; no rule or authority against AI harms is stated.
The administration is said to use data analysis and automation tools, but no AI system is named.
Only an AI policy for technical education in preparation is stated; no tool in service.

facts.fact: Togo First reports that Togo is preparing a national AI strategy for public administration, with a strategy under development, after a symposium held by the justice ministry.

TGO.note: No AI model, dataset or computing is stated as built or hosted.
